functions.name: All non-critical topics
functions.description: Catch-all w.r.t to following for non-critical proposals.

functions.name: Motion
functions.description: Side-effect-less proposals to set general governance direction.

functions.name: Manage nervous system parameters
functions.description: Proposal to change the core parameters of SNS governance.

functions.name: Upgrade SNS controlled canister
functions.description: Proposal to upgrade the wasm of an SNS controlled canister.

functions.name: Add nervous system function
functions.description: Proposal to add a new, user-defined, nervous system function: a canister call which can then be executed by proposal.

functions.name: Remove nervous system function
functions.description: Proposal to remove a user-defined nervous system function, which will be no longer executable by proposal.

functions.name: Execute nervous system function
functions.description: Proposal to execute a user-defined nervous system function, previously added by an AddNervousSystemFunction proposal. A canister call will be made when executed.

functions.name: Upgrade SNS to next version
functions.description: Proposal to upgrade the WASM of a core SNS canister.

functions.name: Manage SNS metadata
functions.description: Proposal to change the metadata associated with an SNS.

functions.name: Transfer SNS treasury funds
functions.description: Proposal to transfer funds from an SNS Governance controlled treasury account

functions.name: Register dapp canisters
functions.description: Proposal to register a dapp canister with the SNS.

functions.name: Deregister Dapp Canisters
functions.description: Proposal to deregister a previously-registered dapp canister from the SNS.

functions.name: Mint SNS tokens
functions.description: Proposal to mint SNS tokens to a specified recipient.

functions.name: Manage ledger parameters
functions.description: Proposal to change some parameters in the ledger canister.

functions.name: Manage dapp canister settings
functions.description: Proposal to change canister settings for some dapp canisters.

functions.name: Advance SNS target version
functions.description: Proposal to advance the target version of this SNS.

functions.name: Set topics for custom proposals

functions.name: Register SNS extension
functions.description: Proposal to register a new SNS extension.

functions.name: Execute SNS extension operation
functions.description: Proposal to execute an operation on a registered SNS extension.

functions.name: Upgrade SNS extension
functions.description: Proposal to upgrade the WASM of a registered SNS extension.

name: KongSwap

topics.name: DAO community settings
topics.description: Proposals to set the direction of the DAO by tokenomics & branding, such as the name and description, token name etc

topics.name: SNS framework management
topics.description: Proposals to upgrade and manage the SNS DAO framework.

topics.name: Dapp canister management
topics.description: Proposals to upgrade the registered dapp canisters and dapp upgrades via built-in or custom logic and updates to frontend assets.

topics.name: Application Business Logic
topics.description: Proposals that are custom to what the governed dapp requires.

topics.name: Governance
topics.description: Proposals that represent community polls or other forms of community opinion but don't have any immediate effect in terms of code changes.

topics.name: Treasury & asset management
topics.description: Proposals to move and manage assets that are DAO-owned, including tokens in the treasury, tokens in liquidity pools, or DAO-owned neurons.

topics.name: Critical Dapp Operations
topics.description: Proposals to execute critical operations on dapps, such as adding or removing dapps from the SNS, or executing custom logic on dapps.
